versions.content: If EthTrcv_SetTransceiverMode() is called with parameter ETH_MODE_ACTIVE and the internal cable diagnostic state is different from ETHTRCV_CABLEDIAG_PENDING, the Ethernet Transceiver driver shall: - Check for wake-up reasons when entering the transceiver's active mode. - If no wake-up reason has been detected, the Ethernet transceiver shall send a wake-up symbol on the bus if configured. - Invoke the call-out <EthTrcvWakeUpCallout> function if configured.
